Alumni Bursary
scholarships.description: – A 20% bursary will be applied to the tuition fees of your chosen postgraduate program for Murdoch University alumni who do not already qualify for a higher percentage Academic Merit Scholarship.

scholarships.description: – A 25% bursary is available to all UAE Citizens (Emirati nationals).
